answer: Re-attestations are stored in quill and wander lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the relic graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 4022 identities would post 4251 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
